preconditions.description: Input integers n (number of beads) and k (pattern parameter) are within the bounds 1 to 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(colors) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in colors)
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n lowercase Latin letters representing bead colors.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(c in '01' for c in output)
postconditions.description: The output is a string of length n consisting of only '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == '1' if is_regular(colors[:i+1], k) else output[i] == '0' for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i (1-based), output[i] is '1' if the first i beads form a regular sequence with parameter k, otherwise '0'.

postconditions.expression: is_regular(colors[:m], k) == any((m == 2 * k + 1 and len(A) + len(B) == m and all(colors[:m] == (A + B) * k + A for A in possible_A for B in possible_B)) or (m == 1 and True) for possible_A in possible_sequences(colors[:m]) for possible_B in possible_sequences(colors[:m]))
postconditions.description: A sequence of length m is regular if it can be expressed as A + B + A + B + ... + A (with 2k+1 summands) for some sequences A and B, or if m=1 (trivially regular).

postconditions.expression: all(len(A) + len(B) == m - len(A) for m in range(1, n+1) for A in possible_sequences(colors[:m]) for B in possible_sequences(colors[:m]) if is_regular(colors[:m], k))
postconditions.description: For any valid regular sequence of length m, the sum of lengths of A and B must satisfy the pattern structure (m = (k+1)*len(A) + k*len(B)).
